title.narrative: Civil Rights Defenders - Human Rights and HR-defenders
Civil Rights Defenders - Mänskliga rättighter och MR-försvarare

description.narrative:
Detta projektstöd till människorättsorganisationer och människorättsförsvarare är inriktat på påverkan, säkerhet och samarbete för att öka möjligheterna till fred och hållbar utveckling i konfliktdrabbade regioner. Projektet har fyra resultat:
1) Ett kontinuerligt informationsutbyte om människorättssituationen genom ett starkt nätverk av lokala aktörer. 2) Förbättrad kapacitet hos lokala aktörer att dokumentera, rapportera och använda uppgifter om kränkningar av de mänskliga rättigheterna. 3) Ökad nationell och internationell uppmärksamhet på människorättssituationen i Arauca. 4) Ökad säkerhet för lokala aktörer.

This project support to Human Rights organisations and Human Rights defenders targets impact, security, and cooperation in order to increase the possibilities for peace and sustainable development in conflict-affected regions. The project has four outcomes:
1) A continuous exchange of information on the human rights situation through a strong network of local actors. 2) Improved capacity among local actors to document, report, and use data on Human Rights violations. 3) Increased national and international attention to the human rights situation in Arauca. 4) Increased security for local actors.

Improve the situation for Human Rights defenders at risk, in the project area, particularly with regards to their security situation and the impact of their work.
This will be achieved through a series of intermediate (or specific) objectives:
OUTCOME 1: A continuous exchange of information on the human rights situation through a strong network of local actors on the two sides of the border.
OUTCOME 2: Improved capacity among local actors on both sides of the border to document, report, and use data on Human Rights violations.
OUTCOME 3: Increased national and international attention to the Human Rights situation in the border area
OUTCOME 4: Increased security for local actor

With the execution of the SIDA-Colombia project, Civil Rights Defenders acquired an important degree of recognition among local and national defenders and Human Rights platforms on both sides of the Colombia-Venezuela border. This aspect is particularly relevant considering that for many years these areas have received some of the largest international cooperation budgets, and local organizations are highly sceptical when new actors come.
CRD have followed-up, through partner organizations such as MAPP-OAS and OHCHR, the development of arbitrary detention cases of the same number of HRDs from the ACA in Arauca. Also, in Venezuela, the partners' close ties with Foro Penal allowed them to keep track of some controversial trials taking place in Venezuela.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
